mechanism: Evaluates the truth-value of the target {{condition}} and yields a {{decision}}: proceed if the condition holds, halt if not, or debt (proceed with obligation recorded) when configured. Unlike a silent filter, a Gate produces a first-class Decision artifact that downstream systems can route on. Whether a halt stops only the item or the enclosing flow is a descendant's choice.
gloss: Filter payload if the target condition is not met
failure_modes: Silent Loss: Important data dropped without alerting the operator.
invariants: Idempotent: Re-evaluating the gate with the same context yields the same result (within validity window).
Every evaluation yields a first-class {{decision}}, including a false one.

parameters.name: on_failure
parameters.description: What a false condition yields: halt, or debt where proceeding with a recorded obligation is configured. Both are {{decision}} values the mechanism names.
